blocks.text: The Healing Therapy Alliance is a collective alliance of professionals, including mind/body and integrative psychotherapists, wellness therapists, and addiction counselors. Our team-based approach values collaboration, individuality, and holistic healing. We have experience working with children, youth, adults, and families who have experienced trauma or struggle with mental wellness or addiction. Our therapists are highly trained and equipped with up-to-date trauma-specific practices grounded in neuroscience and evidence.

blocks.text: At the Healing Therapy Alliance, we offer individualized, wrap-around approaches to healing. Our services include psychotherapy, wellness therapy, and addiction counseling. We focus on healing the whole person, addressing concerns related to physical, cognitive, emotional, spiritual, and attachment systems. Our approach combines evidence-based practices such as cognitive-behavioral therapy, mindfulness, and somatic experiencing to create a balanced and personalized treatment plan.

centre.name: Healing Therapy Alliance
centre.about_html:
The Healing Therapy Alliance is a collective alliance of professionals, including mind/body and integrative psychotherapists, wellness therapists, and addiction counselors. Our team-based approach values collaboration, individuality, and holistic healing. We have experience working with children, youth, adults, and families who have experienced trauma or struggle with mental wellness or addiction. Our therapists are highly trained and equipped with up-to-date trauma-specific practices grounded in neuroscience and evidence.

What do we offer?

At the Healing Therapy Alliance, we offer individualized, wrap-around approaches to healing. Our services include psychotherapy, wellness therapy, and addiction counseling. We focus on healing the whole person, addressing concerns related to physical, cognitive, emotional, spiritual, and attachment systems. Our approach combines evidence-based practices such as cognitive-behavioral therapy, mindfulness, and somatic experiencing to create a balanced and personalized treatment plan.

Why choose us?

Our team-based approach sets us apart from other therapy centers. We believe that collaboration and individualization are the keys to ensuring successful healing. Our therapists are highly trained and continuously expanding their knowledge in evidence-based trauma-specific practices grounded in neuroscience. We offer a holistic approach to healing and are dedicated to providing the best care for our clients. 

How do we provide services during Covid-19?

Due to Covid-19 restrictions, many of our practitioners are working virtually. We offer virtual therapy sessions to ensure the safety and well-being of our clients and our team. If you need to see your therapist in-person, they will make arrangements based on safety protocols.




Healing Therapy Alliance- Center Overview

Healing Therapy Alliance is an excellent rehabilitation center located in Toronto, Ontario. The center is an alliance of psychotherapists and addictions counselors who are dedicated to providing world-class outpatient counseling services. They cater to children, teens, and adults and ensure that their clients achieve long-lasting recovery.

The team at Healing Therapy Alliance incorporates evidence-based practices and holistic techniques to help their clients heal physically, emotionally, and mentally. They offer a range of various therapies including individual therapy and counseling, family therapy, and group therapy. The center also offers amenities such as Nutritional Counseling, Art & Nature Therapy, Yoga & Meditation, among others, to ensure a holistic healing process. The center’s aim is to provide the best care possible, and their highly experienced staff ensures that they deliver that.

Frequently Asked Questions About Healing Therapy Alliance

What types of therapy do you offer?

We offer Psychotherapy, Wellness Therapy, and Addiction Counseling services.

How do I know which therapist is right for me?

Our team of professionals will assess your needs and goals to match you with the appropriate therapist.

How long do the therapy sessions last?

Sessions typically last for 50-60 minutes.

Do you accept insurance?

Yes, we do accept insurance. Please check with your insurance provider to determine your coverage.

How many sessions will I need?

The number of sessions needed varies based on individual needs and goals.

Can couples or families receive therapy?

Yes, we offer therapy services for couples and families as well.

The center is an alliance of psychotherapists and addictions counselors who are dedicated to providing world-class outpatient counseling services. They cater to children, teens, and adults and ensure that their clients achieve long-lasting recovery.

The team at Healing Therapy Alliance incorporates evidence-based practices and holistic techniques to help their clients heal physically, emotionally, and mentally. They offer a range of various therapies including individual therapy and counseling, family therapy, and group therapy. The center also offers amenities such as Nutritional Counseling, Art & Nature Therapy, Yoga & Meditation, among others, to ensure a holistic healing process. The center’s aim is to provide the best care possible, and their highly experienced staff ensures that they deliver that.

Frequently Asked Questions About Healing Therapy Alliance

What types of therapy do you offer?

We offer Psychotherapy, Wellness Therapy, and Addiction Counseling services.

How do I know which therapist is right for me?

Our team of professionals will assess your needs and goals to match you with the appropriate therapist.

How long do the therapy sessions last?

Sessions typically last for 50-60 minutes.

Do you accept insurance?

Yes, we do accept insurance. Please check with your insurance provider to determine your coverage.

How many sessions will I need?

The number of sessions needed varies based on individual needs and goals.

Can couples or families receive therapy?

Yes, we offer therapy services for couples and families as well.
